eventDetail.scope: The 2027 IEEE Workshop on Factory Communication Systems (WFCS) is the largest IEEE conference exclusively dedicated to industrial communication systems and technologies. Its primary aim is to provide a forum for researchers, developers, and practitioners to review and discuss the latest trends, share innovative research directions, and explore future perspectives in the field. The conference focuses on communication solutions that support automation within factories and other industrial contexts, with special attention to recent developments, emerging trends, and new research insights shaping the future of industrial connectivity.
